units.rate: exact-form appearances per million corpus word tokens
units.reach: containing-volume incidences per million corpus volumes

caveats: The fixed corpus reflects the books Google retained and processed; OCR error, metadata error and changing corpus composition remain.
Exact surface forms do not identify meaning, first use, social acceptance or language-wide spelling adoption.
Sparse raw absence is absent_or_suppressed and is never silently converted to observed zero.
Viewer-normalised fractions are not used for the shared joined/spaced scale.

metricConditions.label: RATE
metricConditions.unit: exact-form appearances per million corpus word tokens
metricConditions.headline: 4.172× joined / spaced
metricConditions.interpretation: In the 2010s, joined visibility is 4.172 times the spaced exact form.

metricConditions.label: REACH
metricConditions.unit: containing-volume incidences per million corpus volumes
metricConditions.headline: 3.970× joined / spaced
metricConditions.interpretation: In the 2010s, joined reach across corpus volumes is 3.970 times the spaced exact form.

metricConditions.label: REPEAT
metricConditions.headline: 1.051× joined / spaced
metricConditions.interpretation: In the 2010s, the joined form is repeated only 1.051 times as often inside a containing volume.

railA.label: 1820s
railA.unit: exact-form appearances per million corpus word tokens
railA.interpretation: The pair is unusually visible in the 1820s, led by the spaced form.
railA.caveat: This is a fixed-corpus decade aggregate, not a language-wide peak.
railA.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; 1820–1829; exact raw rows and same-release totalcounts-1.

railA.label: 1980s
railA.unit: exact-form appearances per million corpus word tokens
railA.interpretation: Both exact forms reach the pair's selected low before the later return.
railA.caveat: A low in this corpus does not establish absence from language.
railA.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; 1980–1989; exact raw rows and same-release totalcounts-1.

railA.label: 2010s
railA.unit: exact-form appearances per million corpus word tokens
railA.definition: The latest complete decade in the fixed release.
railA.interpretation: The pair returns to 2.92 times its 1980s rate but remains below the 1820s anchor.
railA.caveat: The 2010s are a partial return, not a full recovery.
railA.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; 2010–2019; exact raw rows and same-release totalcounts-1.

railB.unit: joined share of pair exact-form appearances
railB.definition: Joined exact-form appearances divided by joined plus spaced exact-form appearances in the same year.
railB.interpretation: The first annual crossing in the inspected six-year sequence.
railB.caveat: A yearly crossing is not an irreversible language event; the fixed corpus and its composition bound the result.
railB.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; 1884; exact raw rows and same-release totalcounts-1.

railB.unit: joined share of pair exact-form appearances
railB.definition: Joined exact-form appearances divided by joined plus spaced exact-form appearances in the same year.
railB.interpretation: The following year falls back below equal share.
railB.caveat: A yearly crossing is not an irreversible language event; the fixed corpus and its composition bound the result.
railB.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; 1885; exact raw rows and same-release totalcounts-1.

railB.unit: joined share of pair exact-form appearances
railB.definition: Joined exact-form appearances divided by joined plus spaced exact-form appearances in the same year.
railB.interpretation: The joined form crosses again and remains above in 1887.
railB.caveat: A yearly crossing is not an irreversible language event; the fixed corpus and its composition bound the result.
railB.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; 1886; exact raw rows and same-release totalcounts-1.

railC.label: forever
railC.definition: Rate factor decomposed into reach × repetition ÷ corpus words-per-volume factor.
railC.caveat: This decomposition is an accounting identity, not a causal attribution.
railC.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; complete 1980s and 2010s raw rows and totalcounts-1.

railC.label: for ever
railC.definition: Rate factor decomposed into reach × repetition ÷ corpus words-per-volume factor.
railC.caveat: This decomposition is an accounting identity, not a causal attribution.
railC.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; complete 1980s and 2010s raw rows and totalcounts-1.

railC.label: pair
railC.definition: Combined joined plus spaced exact-form rate in two complete decades.
railC.caveat: The factor describes this fixed corpus release; it is not a causal attribution.
railC.source: googlebooks-eng-20200217; complete 1980s and 2010s raw rows and totalcounts-1.

closingFinding.title: Breadth, not heavier repetition.
closingFinding.sentence: In the 2010s, forever is about four times as visible as for ever, but it is repeated only about five percent more often inside a containing volume. Its modern advantage is overwhelmingly one of breadth across books.

figureContracts.transform: ten-year sums of exact-form numerators and same-release denominators before division
figureContracts.unit: exact-form appearances per million corpus word tokens
figureContracts.missingnessPolicy: all ten annual rows and denominators required; no silent fill
figureContracts.validInterpretation: fixed-corpus long-arc visibility and exact-form composition
figureContracts.prohibitedInterpretation: full recovery, first use, semantics or population spelling adoption

figureContracts.transform: annual exact-form shares plus exposure-weighted 1880s→1890s aggregate changes
figureContracts.denominator: same-year pair exact-form counts for share; same-release word tokens for rate
figureContracts.unit: percent share, percentage points and rate percent change
figureContracts.missingnessPolicy: 1882–1887 and both complete decades required; no silent fill
figureContracts.validInterpretation: joined share turns while joined rate is effectively flat and spaced rate retreats
figureContracts.prohibitedInterpretation: single-year irreversible switch or causal attribution

figureContracts.denominator: same-release word tokens; pair exact-form counts for share
figureContracts.unit: percent share, rate and dimensionless factors
figureContracts.missingnessPolicy: 1980s–2010s complete decades required; no silent fill
figureContracts.validInterpretation: both forms rebound after joined share has settled near four-fifths
figureContracts.prohibitedInterpretation: a second spelling switch or causal mechanism

figureContracts.transform: complete-decade rate, reach and repetition metrics on independent domains
figureContracts.denominator: word tokens for RATE, corpus volumes for REACH, containing volumes for REPEAT
figureContracts.missingnessPolicy: all 1920s–2010s decade inputs required; no silent fill
figureContracts.validInterpretation: the modern joined advantage is primarily breadth across volumes
figureContracts.prohibitedInterpretation: cross-unit magnitude comparison or causal decomposition
